description: The full Phase-1 test suite satisfying the phase-completion gate: the cross-tenant escape suite EXTENDED to every new tenant-owned table (cross-tenant read/write denied, buggy-query backstop, three-GUC-state fail-closed, RLS-forced meta-test, revision append-only), the catalogue-sync meta-test update, and the behavioral tests (configurable structure SEMESTER+2/ANNUAL+1 both valid, exactly-one-ACTIVE, preserve-history, calendar scope/precedence, calendar revision, allowance-engine calendar-read regression, route/permission/audit). Then the full CLEAN build + full vitest gate, all green. Depends on FEAT-001 (migrated schema/DB) and FEAT-002 (the API surface the route/behavioral tests exercise).
steps: Read context.json, this file, and FEAT-002.findings FIRST (for the real route paths + warnings-envelope shape). Read design.md §10 and the escape harness + tenant-escape.integration.test.ts for the established patterns.

apps/api/src/routes/__tests__/helpers/tenant-escape-setup.ts: add 'academic_sessions','academic_terms','programs','academic_calendar_day_revisions' to RLS_TABLES; register academic_calendar_day_revisions in EXPECTED_POLICIES as ['tenant_isolation_select','academic_calendar_day_revisions_tenant_insert'] (the other three use DEFAULT_POLICIES). Seed each tenant (A,B) an AcademicSession (+1 term), a Program, and a department-scoped calendar entry via adminClient; capture ids on SeededTenant. Add the three MUTABLE tables to cleanup() (child-first: terms before sessions; programs before departments; all before the institution — RESTRICT FKs) AND to countRemainingTestRows(). Do NOT seed or delete academic_calendar_day_revisions in the shared teardown (the append-only trigger blocks even adminClient — follow the audit_events precedent).

apps/api/src/routes/__tests__/tenant-escape.integration.test.ts: extend the cross-tenant read-denied, spoofed-write-denied, buggy-query-backstop, and three-GUC-state fail-closed cases to academic_sessions/academic_terms/programs; add an assertion that campass_app cannot UPDATE or DELETE an academic_calendar_day_revisions row (the REVOKE + the trigger). The RLS-forced meta-test (case 6) already iterates RLS_TABLES.
apps/api/src/services/__tests__/catalogue-sync.test.ts: add the new migration dir '<ts>_phase1_academics' to SEEDING_MIGRATION_DIRS so the union includes the four academics.* permissions.

Add Vitest tests for design §10.2-§10.6. Pure-logic tests (precedence rule, term-count suggestion, transition predicates) under apps/api/src/services/__tests__/. DB-touching integration tests under apps/api/src/routes/__tests__/: (a) configurable structure — SEMESTER+2 terms and ANNUAL+1 term both activate cleanly; TRIMESTER+2 activates with a warning; ANNUAL+0 terms rejected; (b) exactly-one-ACTIVE — second activate without handover 409; with handover old->CLOSED and exactly one ACTIVE remains; (c) preserve-history — closing/advancing a session leaves its terms and linked rows intact and readable; (d) calendar revision (self-contained, own prefix; its teardown disables/recreates the trigger within its own adminClient DDL scope, never touching the shared cleanup) — create/update/delete writes revisions capturing previous value + actor; a DELETE revision survives the row deletion; campass_app UPDATE/DELETE on a revision rejected; cross-tenant read denied; fail-closed GUC; (e) calendar scope — institution-wide HOLIDAY and dept-scoped EXAM_DAY on the same date coexist; getEntries with the department returns both with the dept entry winning in effectiveDayType; without it returns the institution-wide one; (f) allowance-engine regression — getRemainingAllowance computes identically with the new nullable columns present and deterministically returns the institution-wide result when an institution-wide and a dept-scoped row share an in-range date; (g) routes/permissions/audit — admin CRUDs sessions/terms/programs/calendar; a role without academics.sessions.manage 403; a student with academics.view reads the current session but cannot mutate; each mutation writes the expected academics.* audit row (re-read audit_events); cross-tenant route access not-found.
Run the full CLEAN build sequence from repo root, then cd apps/api && npx vitest run; fix any failure; clean up throwaway scratch files; leave nothing red.
acceptance_criteria: cd apps/api && npx vitest run src/routes/__tests__/tenant-escape.integration.test.ts is green with teardown row count 0 and the meta-test asserting RLS ENABLE+FORCE on the four new tables and the append-only policy pair on the revision table.
cd apps/api && npx vitest run src/services/__tests__/catalogue-sync.test.ts is green (union includes the four academics.* permissions).
The configurable-structure test proves SEMESTER+2 terms AND ANNUAL+1 term both valid, TRIMESTER+2 warns, ANNUAL+0 is rejected.
The preserve-history test proves closing/advancing a session leaves its terms/rows intact; the revision tests prove append-only (DELETE revision survives; campass_app UPDATE/DELETE rejected).
The allowance-engine regression proves the calendar read is unchanged and deterministic.
The full CLEAN build sequence exits 0 and cd apps/api && npx vitest run reports 0 failures at a total >= the prior baseline plus the new tests.
verification: cd c:/campusgate && npm ci && (cd packages/shared && npx tsc) && npx prisma generate --schema=packages/db/prisma/schema.prisma && (cd apps/api && npx tsc) && npm run build
findings:
DONE & VERIFIED. Full CLEAN build sequence exits 0 (npm ci; shared tsc; prisma generate; apps/api tsc; npm run build) and `cd apps/api && npx vitest run` is green across THREE+ consecutive runs: 31 test files, 259 tests passing, 0 failures. The tenant-escape teardown row-count assertion holds at 0.

ESCAPE SUITE (helpers/tenant-escape-setup.ts + tenant-escape.integration.test.ts): added 'academic_sessions','academic_terms','programs','academic_calendar_day_revisions' to RLS_TABLES; registered the revision table in EXPECTED_POLICIES as ['tenant_isolation_select','academic_calendar_day_revisions_tenant_insert'] (append-only pair; the other three use DEFAULT_POLICIES). seedTenant now seeds each tenant an AcademicSession(+1 term), a Program, and a department-scoped EXAM_DAY calendar entry (ids on SeededTenant). cleanup()/countRemainingTestRows() gained the three MUTABLE tables child-first (calendar days + terms before sessions; programs before departments; all before the institution — RESTRICT FKs). New cases 3i-3p cover cross-tenant read-denied, spoofed-insert-denied + composite-FK, spoofed-update (count 0), buggy-query backstop, and three-GUC-state fail-closed for sessions/terms/programs. Case 6 (meta) now also asserts the revision table (and audit_events) carry NO tenant_isolation_modify policy.

IMPORTANT DEVIATION (design-consistent): the revision append-only UPDATE/DELETE-denied assertion is NOT placed in the SHARED escape suite — seeding a revision there leaves an append-only row that RESTRICTs the shared cleanup()'s institution delete (the exact hazard design §10.1 avoids by keeping revisions OUT of the escape seed, mirroring audit_events). That coverage lives in the self-contained academics-behavioral suite instead (which manages the trigger within its own prefix/DDL scope). An earlier draft that seeded a revision into ESCAPE_TEST_ did strand an orphaned row + two institutions; purged and the approach corrected.

CATALOGUE-SYNC: SEEDING_MIGRATION_DIRS already included '20261027111710_phase1_academics' (FEAT-001), so the union already covers the four academics.* permissions; catalogue-sync.test.ts is green unchanged.

NEW PURE-LOGIC TESTS (DB-free): services/__tests__/academic-session.test.ts (suggestedTermCount; termCountWarning SEMESTER+2/ANNUAL+1 no-warn, TRIMESTER+2 warns, CUSTOM never; termOutsideSession/termOverlap predicates); services/__tests__/calendar-service.test.ts (resolveEffectiveDayType department-wins precedence); services/__tests__/allowance-calendar-regression.test.ts (mocked: engine reads academicCalendarDay with departmentId:null; computes identically with the new nullable columns present; deterministic — institution-wide HOLIDAY wins over a same-date dept WORKING_DAY).

NEW REAL-DB BEHAVIORAL SUITE (routes/__tests__/academics-behavioral.integration.test.ts, prefix ACAD_TEST_, self-contained, retry-wrapped): §10.2 SEMESTER+2 AND ANNUAL+1 both activate clean (no term-count warning), TRIMESTER+2 activates WITH the soft warning, ANNUAL+0 rejected (NO_TERMS); §10.3 second activate without handover => ACTIVE_EXISTS, with handover old->CLOSED and exactly one ACTIVE remains; §10.4 preserve-history (close leaves terms + the linked calendar entry intact/readable), calendar scope (dept EXAM_DAY + institution-wide HOLIDAY coexist; effectiveDayType dept-wins with the dept, institution-wide without), calendar revision (CREATE/UPDATE/DELETE capture previous value + actor; a DELETE revision survives the row deletion), and the append-only + fail-closed revision case (campass_app UPDATE/DELETE rejected by REVOKE + trigger; cross-tenant read denied). Its teardown disables/re-enables the append-only trigger within its OWN adminClient DDL scope, never touching the shared cleanup().

NEW ROUTE/PERMISSION/AUDIT SUITE (routes/__tests__/academics-routes.integration.test.ts): rewritten to MIRROR the existing admin-config-calendar suite — @campusgate/db is MOCKED (deterministic, no live pooler). It pins the ROUTE-LAYER wiring: ADMIN session/program/calendar create returns the { <resource>, warnings } envelope and audits academics.session.created / academics.program.created / academics.calendar.updated (and writes the CREATE revision in-tx); a user without academics.sessions.manage is 403; a STUDENT with academics.view reads current-session but a mutate is 403; a cross-tenant-invisible session (findFirst null) is 404; plus a catalogue/role-binding assertion for the four academics.* keys. RATIONALE for mocking (design §10.6 says 'mirroring admin-config-calendar', which is itself a MOCKED suite): a real-DB route suite drives authenticate's privilegedPrisma pre-tenant reads on the free-tier session pooler and intermittently 500s on transient P1001 that the route layer cannot retry; the real-DB guarantees (RLS isolation, append-only, audit-row PERSISTENCE, the state machine) are already proven by the escape + behavioral real-DB suites, so the route suite proves only the routing/authz/audit WIRING, deterministically.

TEST-RUNNER RELIABILITY (apps/api/vitest.config.ts): set fileParallelism:false. The live-Supabase suites (tenant-escape, superadmin-security, module-system, academics-behavioral) each open session-pooler connections (15-client cap in session mode); on a 16-logical-CPU host Vitest fanned out enough forks to run several at once and tripped EMAXCONNSESSION / transient P1001 mid-suite (this intermittently reddened even the PRE-EXISTING superadmin-security suite). Serial file execution keeps the pooler under its cap; tests within a file still run in order. Reliability bound only — no behaviour change; full run ~2-3 min. All real-DB setup/teardown in the new behavioral suite is withRetry-wrapped for the transient P1001/'Can't reach database server'/max-clients class the free tier throws on inactivity.

CHANGED FILES: apps/api/src/routes/__tests__/helpers/tenant-escape-setup.ts, apps/api/src/routes/__tests__/tenant-escape.integration.test.ts, apps/api/vitest.config.ts, + NEW apps/api/src/services/__tests__/{academic-session,calendar-service,allowance-calendar-regression}.test.ts and apps/api/src/routes/__tests__/{academics-behavioral.integration,academics-routes.integration}.test.ts. No production code changed (FEAT-003 is test-only). No .env staged.
